summary: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger on April 30, 2026, to acquire United Dogecoin Inc. Through the merger, Shuttle's wholly owned subsidiary, Merger Sub, will merge into United Dogecoin, with United Dogecoin surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Shuttle. Consideration for each share of United Dogecoin common stock consists of a pro rata portion of newly designated Series B-1 convertible preferred stock of Shuttle. The closing is expected on May 4, 2026. No specific price per share, premium, or break fee was disclosed. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder votes on the preferred stock issuance.
